c74object.name: tap.garden~
c74object.digest: A generative event loop — the garden that plays itself
c74object.description: The tap.garden~ object is a garden you tend rather than play: the note message plants a note, which snaps to root/scale at entry, strikes a small modal wind chime (four bar-mode doublets at material's ratios — free-free tubes or tuned bars), and returns every loop pass a step quieter (decay) and purer (soften) until it retires below floor. Every pitch is its own tube: its upper modes sit a fixed few cents off the ideal ratios and it hangs at a fixed seat on the stereo rack (spread widens it). Left alone past idle seconds, a seeded gardener strikes on a calm/gust wind cycle (gust sizes the flurries) — deterministic per seed: same seed, same garden, bit for bit. The population converges by construction (per-pass decay is the stabilizer), a fixed sixteen-chime pool bounds the sound, and a sixty-four-event ring bounds the score, the oldest bloom yielding when full. Wrong notes are unrepresentable. A recreation of the published principle behind Eno/Chilvers' generative instruments.

inlet.digest: note messages plant; clear uproots; attributes tend.

method.name: note
method.description: Plant a note: MIDI pitch (fractional accepted) snaps to root/scale at entry; velocity 0..1 (default 0.8). The chime sounds on the next sample and the bloom returns at this loop position every pass until it fades below floor. Resets the gardener's idle clock. A full garden retires its oldest bloom to make room.

method.name: clear
method.description: Uproot everything: kill all blooms and chimes, rewind the loop, re-seed the gardener, restart the idle clock. Parameters are kept.

attribute.name: loop
attribute.description: Loop length in seconds (0.25..120). Instant — the loop is a counter, no tape is bought; blooms keep their positions modulo the new length.

attribute.name: decay
attribute.description: Velocity multiplier per pass (0..1) — the stabilizer: a bloom lives ceil(log(floor/velocity)/log(decay)) passes, always.

attribute.name: soften
attribute.description: Brightness multiplier per pass (0..1): each return is purer, collapsing toward a sine as it recedes.

attribute.name: floor
attribute.description: Retirement threshold (0.0001..1): a bloom whose velocity decays below this is done.

attribute.name: bell
attribute.description: The chime as an attack/decay/brightness triple: envelope times in seconds, brightness 0..1 weighting the upper modes. Applies to future blooms; ringing chimes keep their envelope.

attribute.name: material
attribute.description: What the tubes are made of: chime (free-free tube, ratios 1 : 2.756 : 5.404 : 8.933) or bar (tuned bar, double octaves 1 : 4 : 10 : 20). Accepts the symbol or the index (0..1). Instant — read at strike time, so live blooms re-voice at their next return.

attribute.name: spread
attribute.description: Stereo width of the rack (0..1, default 0.7). Every tube hangs at a fixed seat keyed by its pitch; spread scales how far off center. 0 collapses to mono.

attribute.name: root
attribute.description: Root pitch class, 0..11 (0 = C). Instant; affects future plants only — nothing already planted re-pitches.

attribute.name: scale
attribute.description: The field plants snap to: chromatic, major, minor, majorpentatonic (default), or minorpentatonic. Accepts the symbol or the index (0..4). Instant; affects future plants only.

attribute.name: idle
attribute.description: The gardener's patience: seconds of silence before the garden starts planting for itself. 0 disables self-seeding entirely.

attribute.name: gust
attribute.description: The gardener's wind (0..1, default 0.5): at 0 single unhurried strikes, about one per pass; up from there, flurries of up to five neighboring tubes with longer calms between — the average rate holds.

attribute.name: seed
attribute.description: The gardener's seed. Deterministic: same seed, same garden, bit for bit; different instances decorrelate by seed. 0 folds to the stock seed.

attribute.name: level
attribute.description: Master linear output level, slewed over smooth milliseconds.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Slew time for the level attribute, in milliseconds (0 = instant).
